create_export_graph_signature: create an ExportGraphSignature with input_specs and output_specs describing lifted parameters, buffers, and user inputs
build_input_output_specs: build InputSpec and OutputSpec objects using InputKind and OutputKind enums to classify tensor arguments in an export graph
summarize_export_graph_signature: summarize an ExportGraphSignature by extracting its parameters, buffers, user_inputs, and user_outputs properties
test_backward_signature: test the backward_signature property of an ExportGraphSignature to extract loss_output, gradients_to_parameters, and gradients_to_user_inputs
refactor_graph_signature_names: refactor an ExportGraphSignature by replacing all uses of an old output argument name with a new name using replace_all_uses
